description: This file implements a logger for HTTP/3 frames in the QUIC protocol, including methods for logging stream creation, frame reception, and transmission events, with detailed handling of settings and headers.

classes.name: QuicHttp3Logger
classes.description: Logger class for HTTP/3 events in QUIC, handling logging of stream creation, frame reception, and sending events.

methods.name: OnControlStreamCreated
methods.description: Logs creation of a control stream with its stream ID.

methods.name: OnQpackEncoderStreamCreated
methods.description: Logs creation of a QPACK encoder stream.

methods.name: OnQpackDecoderStreamCreated
methods.description: Logs creation of a QPACK decoder stream.

methods.name: OnPeerControlStreamCreated
methods.description: Logs creation of a peer control stream.

methods.name: OnPeerQpackEncoderStreamCreated
methods.description: Logs creation of a peer QPACK encoder stream.

methods.name: OnPeerQpackDecoderStreamCreated
methods.description: Logs creation of a peer QPACK decoder stream.

methods.name: OnSettingsFrameReceived
methods.description: Logs reception of a SETTINGS frame and records related metrics.

methods.name: OnGoAwayFrameReceived
methods.description: Logs reception of a GOAWAY frame.

methods.name: OnPriorityUpdateFrameReceived
methods.description: Logs reception of a PRIORITY_UPDATE frame.

methods.name: OnDataFrameReceived
methods.description: Logs reception of a DATA frame with stream ID and payload length.

methods.name: OnHeadersFrameReceived
methods.description: Logs reception of HEADERS frame with stream ID and header length.

methods.name: OnHeadersDecoded
methods.description: Logs decoded headers for a stream, eliding header values for logging.

methods.name: OnUnknownFrameReceived
methods.description: Logs reception of an unknown frame with stream ID, type, and length.

methods.name: OnSettingsFrameSent
methods.description: Logs sending of a SETTINGS frame.

methods.name: OnSettingsFrameResumed
methods.description: Logs resumption of a SETTINGS frame.

methods.name: OnGoAwayFrameSent
methods.description: Logs sending of a GOAWAY frame with stream ID.

methods.name: OnPriorityUpdateFrameSent
methods.description: Logs sending of a PRIORITY_UPDATE frame.

methods.name: OnDataFrameSent
methods.description: Logs sending of a DATA frame with stream ID and payload length.

methods.name: OnHeadersFrameSent
methods.description: Logs sending of HEADERS frame with stream ID and headers.
